meta.name: WAR
meta.description: An anthology series set in the elite world of London law following two rival firms, Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne, as they face off in a different headline-making legal battle each season.

videos.title: It's Done
videos.overview: As Morgan and Carla's 10-year marriage hurtles toward divorce, their respective attorneys begin to ramp up their war rooms.

videos.title: No More Nasty Surprises
videos.overview: As Johnny starts his first day, each team attempts to gain the upper hand during mediation. Later, Serena tries to control the narrative.

videos.title: Chip Off the Block
videos.overview: With the prenup thrown into question, Morgan's relationship with his stepson, Gabe, becomes central to both firms' plans.

videos.title: Sing
videos.overview: Nick's insecurities resurface during a crucial arbitration session. Morgan begins to question Cathcarts' tactics.

videos.title: Every Little Thing She Does
videos.overview: While Carla deals with the fallout from a late-night talk show appearance, Morgan is forced to reassure Zephyr's top executives.

videos.title: The Simple Act of Paying Attention
videos.overview: When Molly discovers a troubling error, Johnny tries to downplay the situation, while Serena and Nick question the staff.

videos.title: The Juicy Bit
videos.overview: As the trial begins, Morgan faces pointed questioning from Budgie about Carla's involvement in the early days of Zephyr. Meanwhile, Johnny is tasked with finding proof of a potentially damaging financial transaction.

videos.title: Partners
videos.overview: After a shocking revelation, Carla takes the stand, and Johnny makes a last-ditch effort to save the case...and his career.
